notes.title: Update 1.1.0 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Since the release of Spacepunk Survival, we have received many messages about people enjoying the game! This kind of feedback is invigorating, making us very happy for being able to share our love for this game with our community!

We have also received interesting feedback, suggestions and bug reports from you! Therefore, we are happy to send in this first update many polishes around such feedback!

Let's go to a changelog, shall we?
[b]Bugs fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed error that enabled players in some specific situations to place many turrets.
[*] Fixed error that locked players from shooting when they bought a new weapon while shooting their previous weapon.
[*] Added a collider to the ceiling of starting area. No longer looking to space, okay? lol
[*] Fixed error that caused boss-related music to persist to the main menu when a match was lost during a boss wave.
[*] Fixed the name tag positioning over other players heads.
[/list]

[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the Hunter wave to include other enemies and a more tough hunter.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now, you can disable the helmet model used in the HUD. Good for using greater FOV values.
[/list]

Hope you all enjoy the game with this update! Have fun <3

Be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/KwhgUX8BUh]Discord[/url] and be part of our journey!

Cheers!

notes.title: Get Ready to Survive in Spacepunk Survival: Demo Release Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey adventurers!

We are releasing a new, updated demo for Spacepunk Survival! You can play both with your friends or facing the aliens alone.

Any feedbacks, please join our discord! Or post in the comments for this thread. We will keep an eye out for it!

[b]If you haven't wishlisted the game yet, please do![/b]

Cheers!
- Eduardo
